segments.name: System IP
segments.description: Licenses on-chip interconnect and System IP plus SoC integration automation software and services to semiconductor and system companies.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, the Company has determined that it has a single reportable segment and operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Semiconductor and system companies pay license, support and maintenance fees plus royalties for interconnect and other System IP, software and services.
revenueModel.evidence: Over time, we have expanded and scaled our interconnect IP and other IP businesses to provide hardware, software, documentation, support, and training under a license, support and maintenance fee and a royalty business model, to companies that design and produce semiconductors.
